usage: PROG language-splits [-h] [--data-root DATA_ROOT]
 [--dataset-version {v1,v2,both}]
 [--batch-size BATCH_SIZE] [--dry-run]
 [--log-level {DEBUG,INFO,WARNING,ERROR}]

options:
 -h, --help show this help message and exit
 --data-root DATA_ROOT Data root directory
 --dataset-version {v1,v2,both}
 Select language-split contracts to generate (default: both)
 --batch-size BATCH_SIZE Rows to stream per input batch (default: 65536)
 --dry-run Validate inventories and print the deterministic plan without writing
 --log-level {DEBUG,INFO,WARNING,ERROR}
